token_reduction_document_instruction: Represent this frame for token-level retrieval.
query_instruction: Find the video segment that contains the visual evidence needed to answer the question.
document_instruction: Represent this video segment for retrieval.
protocol_note: True chronological online replay. Each completed 1--16-frame chunk is encoded once by Embedding-2B and appended to a bounded FIFO vector memory. At each query timestamp, retrieval and 8B answering happen immediately using only retained vectors plus the raw recent-frame buffer. Embedding-2B and Qwen3-VL-8B remain simultaneously resident. No full-source index or final visual-token cache is built.
latency_scope: One-time model construction/load is reported separately. Stream-ingest time is measured when each chunk arrives; per-query timings include query embedding, retrieval, evidence decode, optional temporary 2B decoder-token scoring, 8B preprocessing and generation.
